objective: Build a five-loop propose-check-revise benchmark and training path before any further paid fine-tuning.
spend_policy: No paid training, deployment, or provider inference during implementation and offline verification.

tasks.name: benchmark
tasks.proof: 12 scoped tests and Ruff pass; independent-shop CI requires explicit scan-to-shop map; historical raw data unavailable locally.

tasks.name: loop_evaluator
tasks.proof: 8 fake-sampler tests, Ruff and compileall pass; resumable JSONL; no provider calls.

tasks.name: training_data_reward
tasks.proof: Train-only correction rows and reward ranking; 39 scoped tests and a real-checker two-step synthetic smoke passed; no bulk generation.

integration.proof: 35 focused tests and 906 agents tests passed; Ruff C90, compileall, focused mypy on seven files, and git diff --check passed. The existing serverless trainer has 14 pre-existing mypy errors and its training SDK is unavailable locally.
